title: AI安全基准与多模态代理风险暴露，资本涌向基础设施与太空计算
core_insight: AI安全评估从静态内容审核转向动态行为风险监控，同时资本密集流向AI基础设施优化和边缘计算创新

dimension_texts.technology: 多模态代理的行为安全评估框架BeSafe-Bench填补了动态环境风险评估空白，CADSmith通过程序化几何验证提升文本到CAD生成的精确性 DRiffusion提出扩散模型的草稿-精炼并行采样框架，MAGNET实现去中心化自主专家模型生成的新范式 BeSafe-Bench: Unveiling Behavioral Safety Risks of Situated Agents in Functional Environments CADSmith: Multi-Agent CAD Generation with Programmatic Geometric Validation DRiffusion: Draft-and-Refine Process Parallelizes Diffusion Models with Ease
dimension_texts.infrastructure: ScaleOps融资1.3亿美元解决GPU短缺和云成本问题，Rebellions专注AI推理芯片设计以挑战Nvidia Mistral AI融资8.3亿美元建设巴黎数据中心，Starcloud融资1.7亿美元探索太空数据中心建设 ScaleOps raises $130M to improve computing efficiency amid AI demand AI chip startup Rebellions raises $400 million at $2.3B valuation Starcloud raises $170 million Series A to build data centers in space
dimension_texts.application: AI深入建筑电网协同仿真(AutoB2G)、机场管理、医疗数字孪生(Mantis Biotech)等垂直领域 15%美国人接受AI管理者，AI开始替代传统管理层次，Qodo融资7000万美元解决AI生成代码验证问题 AutoB2G: A Large Language Model-Driven Agentic Framework For Automated Building-Grid Co-Simulation 15% of Americans say they'd be willing to work for an AI boss Mantis Biotech is making 'digital twins' of humans
